name: Hag Stone
desc: A pebble with a hole worn right through by the sea. Hung by the door, it keeps the boggarts and bad dreams out.
msg: {name}'s Hag Stone took the sting out of it!

name: Lucky Horseshoe
desc: Nailed points up so the luck can't fall out. Every farrier in the country will tell you so, at length.
msg: {name} held on thanks to its Lucky Horseshoe!

name: Four-Leaf Clover
desc: One in ten thousand, they say, and this one was pressed in a hymn book for safe keeping.
msg: {name}'s Four-Leaf Clover brought a bit of luck!

name: White Heather
desc: Rarer than the purple sort and counted lucky all over Scotland. Tuck a sprig in a pocket before anything that matters.
effect_text: Its hits land critical hits more often.

name: Brigid's Cross
desc: Woven from rushes on the eve of St Brigid's Day and kept in the rafters all year to guard the house.

name: Leek
desc: Wear it proudly. Nobody has ever been told off for a leek.

name: Rowan Sprig
desc: Rowan tree and red thread put the witches to their speed. Tie a sprig over the byre and sleep easy.
msg: {name}'s Rowan Sprig kept the dark at bay!

name: Selkie Pearl
desc: Found in a seal-skin pouch on an Orkney beach. Its owner may come back for it, so be polite.

name: Miner's Lamp
desc: A Davy lamp from a Welsh pit. The miners swore by it, and swore at the coblynau.

name: Thistle Brooch
desc: Nemo me impune lacessit: nobody touches me and gets away with it. The brooch takes this personally.

name: Shamrock Pin
desc: Three leaves, one stem, and a bit of green enamel that has survived several St Patrick's Days.
msg: {name}'s Shamrock Pin patched it up a bit.

name: Oak Acorn
desc: Carried in a pocket for a long life and strong bones. Also squirrels like you more.
effect_text: Defence up when it first comes out.
msg: {name}'s Oak Acorn made it feel sturdy!

name: Lucky Chip
desc: A gold-edged chip from the Palace in Douglas, pressed on you by the pit boss after a very good night. Not legal tender anywhere, including the Palace.
effect_text: Speed up when it first comes out.
msg: {name}'s Lucky Chip put a spring in its step!
